title: Residency review publication and provisional payment instructions
topic: royalty residency effective review withdrawal instruction
applicability: Royalties with pending residency and delivery review
content: The royalty contract’s review_delay_minutes states when requested residency review becomes effective. Its signed result determines the published withholding rate and route eligibility together. The earlier largest-remainder contract continues to determine each gross beneficial entitlement. Until publication, a pending outcome is not a known rate. A beneficiary unaffected by the pending review can be paid under its already-final mandate; review of another person does not suspend that beneficiary’s own obligation. Instruction cancellation does not recall an already transmitted distribution. A delivered amount and a withheld amount must be attributed to the same beneficial owner whose contractual entitlement they discharge.

provenance.scope: Cross-effect of residency review on distribution and channel eligibility.
